<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from catalog/. Do not edit. -->

| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Remove noise | Remove noise, Show one band | Remove noise shrinks the coefficients of every band and rebuilds the image. Show one band shows the coefficients of one level, steered to one angle. |
| **Orientations** `orientations` | 4 | 2, 4, 6, 8 | How many oriented bands each level has, spread over 180 degrees. The angular masks are cos^K with K one less than this number. |
| **Levels** `levels` | 4 | 1 to 6 | How many levels of oriented bands, each an octave of frequency. It is capped at log2 of the short side of the extended image, less 2. |
| **Threshold factor** `factor` | 3 | 0 to 8 | For removing noise, the threshold of each band is this factor times the noise in that band. 0 keeps every coefficient. |
| **Noise sigma** `sigma` | 0 | 0 to 100 | For removing noise, the standard deviation of the noise, in pixel values. 0 estimates it from the finest diagonal wavelet details. |
| **Shrink rule** `mode` | Hard | Hard, Soft | Hard thresholding sets small coefficients to 0 and keeps the others. Soft thresholding also moves the others toward 0 by T. |
| **Band level** `level` | 1 | 1 to 6 | For showing one band, the level to show. 1 is the finest. It is capped at the number of levels. |
| **Line angle** `direction` | 0 | 0 to 180 deg | For showing one band, the band is steered to respond to lines and edges at this angle, counterclockwise on screen. 0 shows horizontal lines. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
